description: Change settings of one of the workspace's recipes by path and save the result as its next version (older versions stay). set is an object of path to value; unset is a list of paths to put back to their defaults. A path that is not a setting is refused with the nearest real one; your own data goes under ext.<area>.<key>. Returns the recipe, notes (what was clamped) and changes, one plain line per setting that changed. A new cover GIF is queued when a change shows in it. note is a few words for the recipe's change log. Call recipe_schema first: it lists every setting with its path, limits, choices and whether the phone draws it yet.

id.description: The recipe's id (see recipe_list with mine=true)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

set.description: Path to new value, for example {"captions.size_pct": 6, "captions.color": {"token": "accent"}}

unset.description: Paths to put back to their default (or ext keys to remove)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_update
title: Change a recipe's settings
